= Indented style output

:word: expanded

[normal#normal-id.role]
  Normal *Bold* {word}.
    Second line.

[quote,Author,Citation]
  Quote *Bold*.
    Second line.

[verse,Author,Citation]
  Verse *Bold*.
    Second line.

[source,rust]
  let value = "*literal* {word}";

[literal]
  Literal *Bold* {word}.
